studies.label: University card-game character design course

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 4, section 3.2 (total participants and random assignment of all selected students); PDF p. 9, Table 1 (analyzed N, Mean, S.D. in each arm; separate excerpts).

arms.name: GAI-SDTS
arms.description: Deepseek and Dreamina with a Double Diamond-Based Design Operation Sheet guiding Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver; operational tool training preceded the design tasks (PDF p. 5, section 3.3; PDF p. 8, section 3.5).

arms.name: GAI
arms.description: Free use of the same Deepseek and Dreamina tools without structured design-thinking guidance; the same operational tool training as GAI-SDTS (PDF p. 5, section 3.3; PDF p. 8, section 3.5).

arms.name: TDL
arms.description: Traditional design learning with printed and online references, hand-drawn sketches, and conventional software such as Photoshop, without generative AI or explicit design-thinking guidance (PDF p. 5, section 3.3).

studies.task: Second-year animation undergraduates independently created a distinctive card-game character with clear personality traits during a university character-design course (PDF p. 4, sections 3.2-3.3).

ai_tool.name: Deepseek and Dreamina
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 5, section 3.3; PDF p. 8, section 3.5. Release years are not stated; the model versions used throughout the experiment are not established.

estimates.outcome: Design achievement: expert-rated composite of final character artwork
estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Two design instructors independently rated anonymized, randomly ordered final artwork. The rubric covers Technical Skill; Adherence to Theme; Composition and Design; Creativity; and Detail Quality and Workload. Each dimension uses a five-point Likert scale, from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest). The aggregation across dimensions and raters is not specified (PDF p. 8, section 3.4).

estimates.notes: This is the broad design-quality composite, coded usefulness; the Creativity rubric dimension is not separately reported. The analysis uses one design-achievement score per student; Table 1 reports participant counts and SDs, and sections 4-4.1 describe one-way ANOVA followed by Tukey HSD. The p_value is the printed pairwise Tukey bound. The reported F is an omnibus test across all study arms, so stats.test is null. The printed arm summaries and pairwise significance appear inconsistent; they are preserved without correction or calculation. No pair-specific total N is printed, so n_total is null rather than calculated from the arm counts. No numerical pairwise difference, SE, confidence interval, or standardized effect is printed. The artwork was produced with AI available in the AI arms and graded at course end; this is immediate assisted production, not a new delayed or unassisted task (PDF p. 9, section 3.5; PDF p. 11, section 5.1).

open_items: The Table 1 arm means, SDs and sample sizes appear inconsistent with the omnibus ANOVA and all-pairs Tukey significance reported in section 4.1 (PDF p. 9). No underlying participant data, corrected statistics or numerical pairwise uncertainty are supplied. Values are transcribed unchanged; no replacement statistics are computed.

The rule for combining rubric dimensions and instructor ratings is not supplied. Separate results for Creativity and the other rubric dimensions are not printed (PDF p. 8, section 3.4; PDF p. 9, Table 1). The extracted outcome is the reported composite only.

Sequence generation and allocation implementation are not described. The paper labels the design quasi-experimental but explicitly reports random assignment of individual students and regrouping across sampled classes (PDF pp. 3-4, sections 3.1-3.2).

Figure 1 labels design achievement ANCOVA and the questionnaire outcomes ANOVA, reversing the Results and table titles. Extraction follows the explicit one-way ANOVA for design achievement in section 4 and Table 1 (PDF p. 4, Figure 1; PDF pp. 9-11, sections 4-4.3 and Tables 1-3).

The experiment-wide Deepseek and Dreamina model versions and release years are unconfirmed. Illustrated Dreamina interface labels do not establish versions used throughout the experiment (PDF p. 7, Figure 6; PDF p. 8, Figure 7; PDF p. 5, section 3.3). ai_tool.year is null.

The external supplement was not retrieved. The main text identifies Supplementary Table S1 as the Double Diamond-Based Design Operation Sheet (PDF p. 5, section 3.3), and PDF p. 14 gives the publisher supplement link. urllib requests to the printed Frontiers link, the DOI, and the publisher article URL from the citation record all failed with WinError 10013. The complete supplement contents remain unverified.

The paper does not print pairwise mean differences, SEs, confidence intervals, standardized effects or pair-specific total participant counts for design achievement (PDF p. 9, Table 1 and section 4.1). These fields remain null.
notes: The complete markdown conversion was read sequentially through the final reference. Text was extracted with pymupdf from every cited PDF page, and Table 1 was independently recovered using find_tables. The PDF has no appended supplement or embedded supplementary files. Figure 1 and the experimental flow diagram were also inspected in memory. The prose reports the total participant sample and random assignment of all selected students; the study analyzed total follows that reported sample, with the arm-specific analyzed counts confirmed in Table 1 and no attrition reported. Initial per-arm allocation counts appear only in Figure 8 (PDF p. 9), so arm n_randomized is left null under the extraction rule excluding figure-only numbers; those cells are not filled from analyzed counts. Classes were sampled before individual assignment; class sampling is not coded as cluster randomization. The methods do not establish session-level assignment. Deepseek supported text dialogue, ideation, prompts and design statements; Dreamina supported generation and refinement of character images (PDF pp. 5-8, sections 3.3-3.5). Conventional references and Photoshop are the usual design-learning comparison, so TDL contrasts are ai_vs_bau. Structured AI use is the tested configuration in the ai_design contrast. All estimates share the same study sample and reuse comparison arms. No pooled-AI contrast, across-people diversity outcome, or unassisted after-AI production task is reported. No preregistration, designated primary outcome, or shared sample with another paper is reported. The raw-data availability statement promises data from the authors without supplying a public data or code URL (PDF p. 14). Source quotes retain the printed decimal precision. No effects, standard errors, differences, or totals of contrast arms were calculated.
